description: Brentuximab vedotin is recommended as an option for treating CD30-positive cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL) in adults after at least 1 systemic therapy, with: mycosis fungoides (MF) stage 2B or above, primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma (pcALCL), or Sézary syndrome. It is recommended only if the company provides brentuximab vedotin according to the commercial arrangement.
